description.narrative: Regional statistical cooperation on the Western Balkans between the National Statistical Institutes in the region and SCB for the period 2013 - 2016. The cooperation is built on SCB together with a Regional Statistics Committee (RSC) is planning the competence development that should be carried out. SCB is providing the main part of the expertis, follow up of the plans is done in the RSC.

Regionalt statistiksamarbete på Västra Balkan mellan statistikbyråerna i regionen och SCB för perioden 2013 - 2016. Samarbetet bygger på att SCB tillsammans med en regional statistikkommitte planerar vilken kompetensutveckling som ska genomföras. SCB står för huvuddelen av expertkunskapen, uppföljning av planerna sker i den regionala kommitten.

This third and next to last phase of the cooperation between Sweden Statistics (SCB) and the national statistics institutes of the Western Balkans has among others resulted in the following examples: The national institutes have enhanced their institutional capacity by among others an increased number of decisions put into action and a structured documentation and evaluation reports made. Annual operational plans and progress reports have been developed and approved. Strengthening environmental statistics through sharing and joint development has among others resulted in that new indicators have been developed within environmental statistics among others for GHG emissions in accordance to EU and international standards and waste treatment data. In Serbia water exploitation index and generation of waste statistics have among others been produced. Gender statistis have been developed and all national statistical institutions have ten new gender indicators, well reaching the target set. Among others the gender pay gap (GPG) have been developed and utilised. Given an increased availability of data, gender statistics are utilised to a greater extent by stakeholders in reporting, decision and policy making.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
